title: RM500 monthly aid to support Norhazwani's two daughters
summary: TUMPAT: The sister of Malaysia Border Control and Protection Agency (MCBA) officer Norhazwani Ibrahim, who was killed last week, is expected to receive RM500 in monthly assistance to help care for the victim’s two young daughters.

title_en: The King gives gifts to police injured in shooting
